name: Badge / Card Cloning During Access
description: Once physical access is achieved, opportunities arise to clone credentials from unattended badge holders, charging docks, or staff desks. A cloned credential extends access beyond the initial entry window and enables re-entry or persistence. This is distinct from long-range skimming — this technique involves direct proximity to an unattended or briefly exposed card, which is possible once inside the facility.

blue.det: Cloned credential used after engagement window; simultaneous credential use; anti-passback violation in access control logs.
blue.cm: Anti-passback rules; credential geofencing; monitor for simultaneous credential use; DESFire EV2/EV3 with AES-128 prevents cloning.
